item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran's Geopolitical Impact on Oil and Markets — Stock markets and oil prices remain volatile amid Iran conflict fears
item.description: Experts have warned that the ongoing volatility in stock markets and oil prices, driven by fears that the conflict involving Iran may continue, could lead to higher costs for goods and services if oil and gas prices remain elevated.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran's Geopolitical Impact on Oil and Markets — Global X suggests increased focus on emerging markets amid Iran conflict
item.description: Global X has indicated that the ongoing conflict involving Iran may present an opportunity to increase investments in emerging markets. This perspective comes as geopolitical tensions continue to influence equities, commodities, and currencies globally.

item.title: [ESCALATING] Iran's Geopolitical Impact on Oil and Markets — UK firms withdraw fixed energy deals amid Iran conflict-driven price surge
item.description: UK firms have significantly reduced the availability of fixed-term energy deals as wholesale energy prices surge due to the ongoing conflict involving Iran. The data indicates that the number of such deals has more than halved, reflecting the volatility and uncertainty in the energy market.
